title: Jack Rabbit Rachael Rabbit Orange, Mango and Passionfruit Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Rachael Rabbit’s Orange, Mango & Passionfruit is a sublime tropical and a holiday in a 10ml bottle. Fresh and juicy oranges and mangoes greet you on the inhale followed by the deep and tangy sweetness of Passionfruit, all finished to exquisite perfection with a cooling jolt of menthol ice. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
